title: Headers and fields odt 001
notes: real ODF master-page header/footer in styles.xml (style:master-page "Standard", A4 page-layout pm1): header carries two text:field elements (text:field-name page-number / page-count, integer value-type, cached display "1 / 1"). Honest caveats: (a) the normative text:field counter scans content.xml only, so these styles.xml field elements count 0 in the manifest; (b) the page fields are generic text:field user-field elements carrying cached display text, not dedicated text:page-number/text:page-count — LibreOffice shows the cached values; (c) header/footer strings are excluded from the reference text because renderers re-evaluate/re-position header content per page.
